faq.question: Q1. What is the recruitment organisation for Farmer change Agent (FCA)?
faq.answer: The recruitment is conducted by Acharya Narendra Deva University of Agriculture & Technology (ANDUAT), Kumarganj, Ayodhya.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are available for Farmer change Agent (FCA)?
faq.answer: There are a total of 10 vacancies available for the Farmer change Agent (FCA) post.

faq.question: Q3. When is the walk-in interview for ANDUAT FCA recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The walk-in interview will be held on 15 October 2026 at 11:00 AM, with reporting time from 9:30 AM to 10:30 AM.

faq.question: Q4. What is the venue for the walk-in interview?
faq.answer: The interview will be held at the Directorate of Extension, A.N.D.U.A.T., Kumarganj, Ayodhya-224229.

faq.question: Q5. What is the educational qualification required for Farmer change Agent (FCA)?
faq.answer: Candidates must have passed 10+2 or an equivalent examination.

faq.question: Q6. What is the age limit for the FCA post?
faq.answer: The age limit is 18 to 40 years.

faq.question: Q7. What is the remuneration for the Farmer change Agent position?
faq.answer: Selected candidates will receive a remuneration of Rs. 12,000/- per month for a period of six months.

faq.question: Q8. Is there an application fee for ANDUAT FCA recruitment?
faq.answer: The notification does not mention any application fee.
